To,
The Chief, Cyber Bureau,
Nepal Police, Bhotahity, Kathmandu.
Subject: Complaint regarding online fraud impersonating eSewa (Cashback Scam)
Respected Sir/Madam,
I, Sunita Gurung, resident of Pokhara-6, Kaski, holder of eSewa ID
sunita.gurung21@gmail.com and mobile number 9847011223, would like to file a complaint
regarding an online fraud I fell victim to between 10 June 2026 and 14 June 2026.
On 10 June 2026, I received an SMS claiming to be from "eSewa" stating that I had won a
Dashain Cashback offer of NPR 5,000, and asking me to visit the link
https://esewa-cashback-offer.xyz/claim to claim it. I later received messages on Facebook
Messenger from an account calling itself "eSewa Cashback Support," which asked me to
confirm my eSewa ID and phone number, and then requested a "verification fee" of NPR 200,
which I paid to the eSewa ID esewa.cashback99@gmail.com on 11 June 2026 (Transaction
ID: 0119.0625.987456).
Following this, the same contact, using phone/Khalti ID 9801122334, asked me to pay an
additional processing fee of NPR 1,500 through Khalti (Transaction Code:
KH-2026-0611-77245) to release a larger prize of NPR 25,000. I also received a phishing
email from "support@esewa-verify-kyc.com" threatening that my account KYC would be
suspended, again directing me to the same link and phone number +977-9801122334.
On 14 June 2026, believing the prize was genuine, I transferred NPR 25,000 via
Machhapuchhre Bank Limited (Voucher No. MBL-2026-441829) to an account held in the
name "Rabin Thapa," Account Number 0501-9012345678, at Machhapuchhre Bank Limited,
Kathmandu Branch.
After this transfer, all communication from the contact stopped, and I was unable to reach the
phone number 9801122334 again. I later learned that eSewa does not conduct cashback
promotions in this manner and that the link used does not belong to eSewa's official domain.
I am attaching screenshots of the SMS, the Messenger conversation, the QR code flyer I was
sent, my eSewa and Khalti payment confirmations, and the bank transfer voucher as
supporting evidence. I respectfully request the Cyber Bureau to investigate this matter, trace
the phone number, Khalti ID, bank account, and the phishing domain involved, and take
appropriate legal action against the perpetrators.
Thank you for your attention to this matter.
Sincerely,
